title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
ii.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
iii.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
iv.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
v.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
colophon: a symmetry that almost holds, and the light that finds where it doesn't.
